title: Leisure
author: W. H. Davies
original:
What is this life if, full of care,
We have no time to stand and stare.
No time to stand beneath the boughs
And stare as long as sheep or cows.
translation:
生活若是满心忧虑，
便没空驻足凝望。
没空站在枝下，
像牛羊般久久张望。

title: The Eagle
author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
translation:
他弯曲的利爪扣住峭壁；
在孤绝之地贴近太阳，
立于湛蓝世界的环抱。
皱起的海面在脚下缓行；
他从山崖俯瞰，
如一道闪电般坠落。

title: Daffodils
author: William Wordsworth
original:
I wandered lonely as a cloud
That floats on high o'er vales and hills,
When all at once I saw a crowd,
A host, of golden daffodils.
translation:
我如一朵云孤独游荡，
飘过溪谷与山岗，
忽见一簇金黄水仙，
在微风里纷纷绽放。

title: A Thing of Beauty
author: John Keats
original:
A thing of beauty is a joy for ever:
Its loveliness increases; it will never
Pass into nothingness; but still will keep
A bower quiet for us, and a sleep
Full of sweet dreams.
translation:
美的事物是永恒的喜悦：
它的可爱与日俱增，永不
归于虚无；它为我们留一处
静谧的亭荫，与甜梦沉沉的安睡。

title: The Mountain Stream
author: 星海
original:
The stream learns the shape of every stone,
yet never stops to argue with the floor.
It sings because the falling is its own,
and reaching the sea is only one door more.
translation:
溪流懂得每颗石头的形状，
却从不停下与河床争辩。
它歌唱，因坠落属于自己，
而汇入大海只是又一道门。

title: Snow
author: 星海
original:
Snow does not apologize for covering the world.
It simply offers white, and asks for nothing back,
a quiet lesson in how to begin again.
translation:
雪不为覆盖世界而道歉。
它只是献出洁白，不索回报，
教我们如何安静地重新开始。

title: The Wind
author: 星海
original:
The wind is the only letter the earth ever sends,
written in no ink, read by every leaf.
If you are still enough, it spells your name.
translation:
风是大地寄出的唯一书信，
不用墨写，却被每片叶读。
若你足够安静，它便拼出你的名字。

title: Rain at Night
author: 星海
original:
Night rain is the world breathing slow,
washing the roads until they shine like rivers.
Sleep, and let the dark do its gentle work.
translation:
夜雨是世界缓慢的呼吸，
把街道洗得如河流般发亮。
睡吧，让黑暗做它温柔的事。

title: The Old Oak
author: 星海
original:
The old oak keeps a century of weather in its rings,
and still it opens new leaves to a stranger sun.
That is what it means to endure.
translation:
老橡树把百年风雨藏进年轮，
仍向陌生的太阳展开新叶。
这便是"坚守"的含义。

title: Why We Walk in Forests
author: 星海
original: We do not go to the forest to escape life. We go to remember that life was never only human. The trees keep a slower clock, and standing among them, we learn to keep ours.
translation: 我们去森林并非逃避生活，而是记得生活从不只属于人类。树木守着更慢的钟，立于其间，我们学会守住自己的节拍。

title: The Sea Teaches Distance
author: 星海
original: The sea teaches a simple truth: that most of what matters is hidden, vast, and patient. We only see the surface, yet we trust the deep.
translation: 大海教我们一个朴素真理：重要的多半藏得深、广而恒久。我们只见海面，却信赖深海。

title: A Field in Morning
author: 星海
original: A field at morning holds no opinion about you. It simply grows, and in its growing offers the rare gift of being unimportant for a while.
translation: 清晨的田野对你毫无评判，只是生长；在生长中，它赠你一份稀有的礼物——暂时变得无足轻重。

title: Stars Are Honest
author: 星海
original: Stars do not perform for us. They burn because that is what they are, and their light reaches us only after a long, honest journey. Be like the star: shine without the need to be seen.
translation: 星辰不为我们表演。它们燃烧，只因本如此；光抵达我们前，走过了漫长而诚实的旅程。做人如星：发光，无需被看见。

title: The River Never Returns
author: 星海
original: A river never returns to its source, yet it is faithful to the shape of the land. Movement and loyalty are not opposites; the river proves it.
translation: 河水从不回源头，却忠于大地的轮廓。流动与忠诚并非对立，河流便是证明。

title: Listening to Stones
author: 星海
original: A stone has survived everything and said nothing. Sit with one long enough, and you may learn the oldest language: patience, worn smooth by time.
translation: 石头熬过一切，却一言不发。与它久坐，你或能学会最古老的语言：被时光磨平的耐心。

title: On Wonder
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
original: Live in the sunshine, swim the sea, drink the wild air.
translation: 活在阳光下，游于海中，饮下野性的风。

title: On Stillness
author: 星海
original: The earth never hurries, yet everything is accomplished.
translation: 大地从不匆忙，却成就万物。

title: On the Sky
author: 星海
original: Keep a little sky inside you, so even indoors you can breathe.
translation: 心中留一角天空，即便在室内也能呼吸。

title: On Roots
author: 星海
original: A tree is judged by its fruit, but it is fed by its roots.
translation: 树以果实被评判，却以根被滋养。

title: On Seasons
author: 星海
original: Every season is a language; learn to be fluent in all of them.
translation: 每个季节都是一种语言，学会精通它们全部。

title: On Light
author: 星海
original: Dawn does not announce itself; it simply arrives, and the world is changed.
translation: 黎明从不宣告，只是到来，世界便已不同。

title: On the Moon
author: 星海
original: The moon is faithful: it loses itself each month and is always found.
translation: 月亮是忠贞的：每月迷失，却总被寻回。

title: On Growth
author: 星海
original: A seed does not fear the dark; it knows the dark is only the first half of rising.
translation: 种子不惧黑暗，它知黑暗只是升起的前半程。

title: On Weather
author: 星海
original: Do not blame the weather for your mood; learn to dance in the rain you cannot stop.
translation: 别因心情责怪天气；学着在无法阻止的雨中起舞。

title: On the Earth
author: 星海
original: We did not inherit the earth from our parents; we borrow it from our children.
translation: 我们不是从父辈继承地球，而是向子孙借来。

title: If—
author: Rudyard Kipling
original:
If you can keep your head when all about you
Are losing theirs and blaming it on you,
If you can trust yourself when all men doubt you...
translation:
若众人失去理智却怪你，
你仍能保持清醒；
若众人怀疑你，你仍信自己……

title: Invictus
author: William Ernest Henley
original:
Out of the night that covers me,
Black as the pit from pole to pole,
I thank whatever gods may be
For my unconquerable soul.
I am the master of my fate,
I am the captain of my soul.
translation:
走出笼罩我的长夜，
漆黑如深渊无垠，
我仍感谢众神，
赐我不可征服的灵魂。
我是命运的主宰，
我是灵魂的船长。

title: A Psalm of Life
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
original:
Tell me not, in mournful numbers,
Life is but an empty dream!
For the soul is dead that slumbers,
And things are not what they seem.
translation:
别用哀伤的诗句告诉我，
人生只是一场空梦！
沉睡的灵魂已然死去，
事物并非表面那般。

title: The Road Not Taken
author: Robert Frost
original:
Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
And sorry I could not travel both
And be one traveler, long I stood...
translation:
黄树林里分出两条路，
遗憾不能都走，
作为旅人我久久伫立……

title: The Guest House
author: Mevlana Rumi
original:
This being human is a guest house.
Every morning a new arrival.
A joy, a depression, a meanness,
some momentary awareness comes
as an unexpected visitor.
translation:
做人犹如一间客栈。
每日都有新客降临。
喜乐、消沉、卑琐，
某种片刻的觉知，
如不速之客来访。

title: Carpe Diem
author: 星海
original:
Gather the ripe day before the frost,
for the orchard keeps no promise of tomorrow.
What is given now is the only gift that is certain.
translation:
在寒霜前采下成熟的日子，
果园从不许诺明天。
此刻所予，是唯一的笃定之礼。

title: The Unfinished Letter
author: 星海
original:
We are letters still being written,
each day a new line in a hand not our own.
Do not rush the ending; the pause is part of the prose.
translation:
我们是被书写的信，
每日添一行，笔迹非己。
别催结局；停顿亦是散文的一部分。

title: Middle Age
author: 星海
original:
Middle age is the stair between two windows:
you have seen the lower view, not yet the higher,
and the climb itself becomes the light.
translation:
中年是两扇窗之间的楼梯：
已看过低处的风景，未见高处，
而攀登本身成了光。

title: To the Younger Me
author: 星海
original:
I would tell the younger me: the scars are not spoils of war,
they are the map. Read them, and you will find the way home.
translation:
我想对年轻的自己说：伤疤不是战利品，
而是地图。读它，你便找到归途。

title: On Failure
author: 星海
original: Failure is not the opposite of success; it is the soil in which success is rooted. Every person you admire has simply failed better than others.
translation: 失败不是成功的反面，而是成功扎根的土壤。你敬仰的人，只是比他人失败得更漂亮。

title: On Choosing
author: 星海
original: We often fear choosing wrong, yet the greater risk is choosing nothing. A path walked badly still moves you forward; a road unwalked keeps you exactly where you are.
translation: 我们常怕选错，更大的险却是什么都不选。走坏的路仍向前，未走的路让你原地不动。

title: On Being Ordinary
author: 星海
original: The world praises the extraordinary, but most of a good life is ordinary: a warm meal, a clear morning, a kind word. Do not despise the small; it is where happiness lives.
translation: 世人赞非凡，但好生活多半平凡：一顿暖饭、一个清亮的早晨、一句善意。别轻视细微，幸福就住在那里。

title: On Growing Older
author: 星海
original: To grow older is not to shrink but to deepen. The young rush to the surface; the old have learned the value of the current beneath.
translation: 变老不是缩小，而是变深。年轻人冲向表层，老者已懂得暗流之价值。

title: On Kindness
author: 星海
original: Kindness costs little and earns much. A single gentle act can outlive the day that bore it, echoing in a stranger far longer than you will ever know.
translation: 善意代价小，获益多。一次温柔之举可胜过诞生它的那一天，在陌生人心里回响得比你想象的更久。

title: On Letting Go
author: 星海
original: Letting go is not losing; it is making room. The hands that release the old are the same hands free to hold the new.
translation: 放手不是失去，而是腾出空间。松开旧物的手，正是腾空去接新物的手。

title: On Doing
author: Confucius
original: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
translation: 只要不停下，走得慢也无妨。

title: On Falling
author: Confucius
original: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
translation: 最大的荣耀不在永不跌倒，而在每次跌倒后站起。

title: On Action
author: William James
original: Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
translation: 就当你的作为举足轻重。它确实如此。

title: On Self
author: Polonius (Shakespeare)
original: This above all: to thine own self be true.
translation: 最重要者：对自己要真诚。

title: On Experience
author: 星海
original: We are the sum of what we have lived, not what we have planned.
translation: 我们是所历之事的总和，而非所计划之事。

title: On the Present
author: 星海
original: Yesterday is a letter sent; tomorrow is one not yet written. Today is the ink in your hand.
translation: 昨日是寄出的信；明日是未写的信。今日是你手中的墨。

title: On Worth
author: 星海
original: Your value is not set by the crowd; it is revealed by the life you choose to live.
translation: 你的价值不由人群定，而由你选择的生活显现。

title: On Peace
author: 星海
original: Peace is not the absence of noise, but the presence of order within.
translation: 平静不是没有喧闹，而是内心有秩序。

title: On Change
author: 星海
original: You cannot step twice into the same life; the river of self flows on.
translation: 你无法两次踏入同一段人生；自我的河流奔流不息。

title: On Courage
author: 星海
original: Courage is not the lack of fear, but the decision that something else matters more.
translation: 勇气不是没有恐惧，而是认定另有其事更为重要。

title: Sonnet 18
author: William Shakespeare
original:
Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
Thou art more lovely and more temperate:
Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May...
translation:
我可否把你比作夏日？
你更可爱也更温婉：
狂风摇落五月娇蕊……

title: How Do I Love Thee
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning
original:
How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.
I love thee to the depth and breadth and height
My soul can reach, when feeling out of sight.
translation:
我怎样爱你？让我细数。
我爱你直到灵魂能及的深、广、高，
在目光不及之处。

title: When You Are Old
author: W. B. Yeats
original:
When you are old and grey and full of sleep,
And nodding by the fire, take down this book,
And slowly read, and dream of the soft look...
translation:
当你年老，灰发，睡意沉沉，
炉边打盹时取卷此书，
缓缓读，梦那柔和的眼神……

title: Love Is Not All
author: Edna St. Vincent Millay
translation:
爱并非全部：不是肉也不是酒，
不是安睡，也不是遮雨的屋顶；
却仍有许多人甘愿迷失……

title: The Rose and the Thorn
author: 星海
translation:
爱是玫瑰，刺是它诚实的孪生；
你不能只握花而拒痛。
智者双手皆捧，给那疼取一个名字。

title: Distance
author: 星海
original:
Distance is only a test of love, not its enemy.
The root still feeds the flower it cannot see.
translation:
距离是爱的试金石，而非仇敌。
根仍滋养它看不见的花。

title: The Quiet Kind
author: 星海
translation:
最喧闹的爱并非最真；
安静的那种在烟花散后仍在，
泡茶，且真心实意。

title: First Light
author: 星海
original:
I knew it was love when morning became
a person, and the coffee smelled of someone else's laugh.
translation:
当清晨成了某个人，
咖啡飘着他人笑声，
我便知那是爱。

title: The Letter Unsent
author: 星海
original:
Some loves live only in the letter never sent,
kept safe by the stamp that was never licked,
more perfect for being unspent.
translation:
有些爱只活在未寄出的信里，
因未舔的邮票而完好，
因未曾耗费而更完美。

title: On Staying
author: 星海
original: Love is easy to begin and hard to stay. Anyone can be swept away; few can choose, every ordinary Tuesday, to remain. That choosing is the real romance.
translation: 爱易开始而难相守。谁都能被卷走，鲜少有人能在每个平凡的周二选择留下。那选择，才是真正的浪漫。

title: On Respect
author: 星海
original: The deepest love is not the one that completes you, but the one that respects your incompleteness. Two whole solitudes are worth more than one fused half.
translation: 最深的爱不是补全你，而是尊重你的不完整。两个完整的独处，胜过一个融合的半体。

title: On Heartbreak
author: 星海
original: Heartbreak is love's tuition; painful, but it teaches you the shape of your own heart. Do not wish it away. Wish instead to learn, and to love again, wiser.
translation: 心碎是爱的学费，痛却教你认识自己心的形状。别祈它离去，祈自己学会，并更智慧地再爱。

title: On Small Things
author: 星海
original: Grand gestures fade; it is the small, repeated kindness that builds a life together. Love is mostly a thousand unnoticed mercies.
translation: 盛大姿态会褪色；是细小而重复的善意砌出共同生活。爱多半是千次不被注意的慈悲。

title: On Freedom in Love
author: 星海
original: Healthy love does not clip your wings; it builds a sky you want to return to. If love asks you to disappear, it was never love.
translation: 健康的爱不剪你羽翼，而筑一片你想回的天空。若爱要你消失，那从不是爱。

title: On Choice
author: 星海
original: We do not find love; we choose it, daily, after the spark has cooled.
translation: 我们不是找到爱，而是每日在火花冷却后选择它。

title: On Trust
author: 星海
original: Trust is the fabric of love; a single tear can unravel years.
translation: 信任是爱的织物；一滴泪可拆散多年。

title: On Time
author: 星海
original: Real love is spelled with time, not just feeling.
translation: 真爱用时间拼写，不止用感觉。

title: On Presence
author: 星海
original: The greatest gift of love is not a rose, but your full attention.
translation: 爱最珍贵的礼物不是玫瑰，而是你全然的专注。

title: On Equality
author: 星海
original: Love grows best when two people stand, not one kneels.
translation: 当两人都站立而非一人跪下，爱长得最好。

title: On Memory
author: 星海
original: To be loved is to be remembered even in a crowded room.
translation: 被爱，便是在拥挤的房间里仍被记起。

title: On Healing
author: 星海
original: The right love does not fix you; it sits with you while you fix yourself.
translation: 对的爱不修补你，而是陪你修补自己。

title: On Honesty
author: 星海
original: Say the true thing gently; love dies more often by silence than by words.
translation: 温柔地说真话；爱多死于沉默而非言语。

title: On Home
author: 星海
original: Home is not a place; it is a person who makes the place irrelevant.
translation: 家不是地点，而是让你无视地点的人。

title: On Patience
author: 星海
original: Love is a language; some learn it late, but none too late to be understood.
translation: 爱是一种语言；有人学得晚，但无一晚到不被听懂。

title: On Giving
author: 星海
original: The heart that gives, gathers; love multiplies by spending.
translation: 付出的心反有所得；爱因付出而倍增。

title: Still I Rise
author: Maya Angelou
original:
You may write me down in history
With your bitter, twisted lies,
You may tread me in the very dirt
But still, like dust, I'll rise.
translation:
你尽可在史册写我，
用苦涩扭曲的谎言，
尽可将我踩入泥尘，
但我如尘，仍会升起。

title: Don't Quit
author: Edgar A. Guest
original:
When things go wrong, as they sometimes will,
When the road you're trudging seems all uphill,
Rest if you must, but don't you quit.
translation:
当事情出错——它时有发生，
当你跋涉的路似全在上坡，
可以歇，但别放弃。

title: The Hill
author: 星海
translation:
山不在意谁攀登；
它给强弱同样的风。
重要的是那再次抬起脚的人。

title: The Blacksmith
author: 星海
translation:
你是自己门扉的铁匠；
锤沉重，铁冰冷，
但形状由你打造。

title: Morning Resolve
author: 星海
original:
Each morning is a fresh page and a steady pen;
write one honest line, and the day is already won.
translation:
每个清晨是新页与稳笔；
写一行诚实的字，这天便已胜。

title: The Lighthouse
author: 星海
original:
Be the lighthouse, not the ship:
others will weather storms by the steady light you keep,
even when you cannot see the shore.
translation:
做灯塔，而非船：
他人借你守的稳光渡风暴，
即便你不见岸。

title: Try
author: 星海
original:
A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not
what ships are built for. Launch, and trust the sea.
translation:
停港的船安全，却非
船被造的用意。启航，信海。

title: The Climb Matters
author: 星海
original:
Do not measure the mountain only by the peak;
the climb is the part that makes you able to stand there.
translation:
别只以峰量山；
攀登才是让你立于彼处的原因。

title: Unbroken
author: 星海
translation:
他们能夺路，夺不走行路者；
能夺天气，夺不走意志。
守住后者，你便抵达。

title: On Starting
author: 星海
original: The hardest part of any work is the first sentence, the first step, the first coin. Begin before you feel ready; readiness is a feeling that arrives after the start, not before.
translation: 任何事最难的是首句、首步、首币。在准备好前就开始；就绪之感始于开始后，而非之前。

title: On Discipline
author: 星海
original: Motivation gets you started; discipline keeps you going. Wait for the mood and you will wait forever. Show up on the dull days, and the dull days build the life.
translation: 动力让你起步，纪律让你持续。等心情你将永远等。在平淡日也出现，平淡日筑出人生。

title: On Fear
author: 星海
original: Fear is a signal, not a sentence. It tells you where the edge is, not that you must turn back. Walk to the edge, look, and then decide with open eyes.
translation: 恐惧是信号，非判决。它指边界所在，非令你回头。走到边缘，看，再睁眼抉择。

title: On Small Steps
author: 星海
original: Great things are only small things that refused to stop. The wall is built one brick at a time; so is a life worth admiring.
translation: 伟业只是不肯停的小事。墙一砖一砖砌成，值得敬仰的人生亦然。

title: On Comparison
author: 星海
original: Comparison is the thief of joy, but it can be a teacher if used right: learn the craft, ignore the score. Run your own race at your own pace.
translation: 比较是快乐的小偷，用得好却是老师：学技艺，忽略比分。以自己节奏跑自己的赛。

title: On Setbacks
author: 星海
original: A setback is a setup; it rearranges you for a better attempt. The athlete who never fell never learned the fall that saves the match.
translation: 挫折是铺垫，它重整你以更好尝试。从未跌倒的选手，学不会救场的那一摔。

title: On Effort
author: Thomas Edison
original: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
translation: 天才是百分之一灵感加百分之九十九汗水。

title: On Beginning
author: Chinese Proverb
original: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
translation: 千里之行，始于足下。

title: On Courage
author: Ambrose Redmoon
original: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the judgment that something else is more important.
translation: 勇气不是没有恐惧，而是判断另有其事更重要。

title: On Persistence
author: Calvin Coolidge
original: Nothing in the world can take the place of persistence.
translation: 世上没有任何东西能取代坚持。

title: On Action
author: 星海
original: Dreams don't work unless you do.
translation: 梦想不会实现，除非你行动。

title: On Limits
author: 星海
original: The limit is not the sky; the limit is the story you tell yourself.
translation: 极限不在天空，而在你对自己讲的故事。

title: On Practice
author: 星海
original: Mastery is practice in disguise; do it again, and again, until easy looks like gift.
translation: 精通是伪装的练习；做一次又一次，直到轻松看似天赋。

title: On Now
author: 星海
original: The best time to plant was ten years ago; the second best is now.
translation: 种树最好的时机是十年前，其次是现在。

title: On Strength
author: 星海
original: You have been broken and you are still here; that is strength enough to begin.
translation: 你曾破碎却仍在此；这已是起步足够的力量。

title: On Belief
author: 星海
original: Believe you can, and you are already halfway there.
translation: 相信自己能，你便已行至半途。

title: The Conqueror
author: 星海
translation:
胜人者有力，
自胜者强。
后者才是值得赢的战。

title: The Two Wolves
author: 星海
original:
Inside us two wolves fight: one of anger, one of peace.
The one that wins is the one you feed.
translation:
心中两狼相争：一为怒，一为静。
胜者是你所喂养的那只。

title: The River of Thought
author: 星海
original:
Thoughts are rivers; you are not the water,
you are the bank that watches it pass.
Step back, and the current loses its grip.
translation:
思绪如河；你非水，
而是望它流过的岸。
退后，急流便失其掌控。

title: The Mask
author: 星海
original:
We wear a face to meet the faces that we meet,
but the soul keeps a quieter, truer seat.
Learn the difference, and you are free.
translation:
我们戴一张脸去见众脸，
灵魂却守着更安静更真的座。
辨其别，你便自由。

title: The Question
author: 星海
original:
Better the question that wakes you
than the answer that lets you sleep.
Wonder is the door; certainty, the wall.
translation:
宁可要唤醒你的问题，
也不要让你安睡的答案。
好奇是门，确定是墙。

title: On Knowing
author: 星海
translation:
真知是知道自己所知甚少。
满杯盛不下雨；
空杯方成溪。

title: The Mirror
author: 星海
original:
The world is a mirror with a kind of mind:
it gives back the gaze you send.
Look with wonder, and wonder returns.
translation:
世界是一面有心的镜：
回你投出的目光。
以好奇望，好奇便回。

title: The Pendulum
author: 星海
translation:
喜与悲是一摆；
止摆即止生。
摆吧，二者皆名"活"。

title: The Uncarved Block
author: 星海
translation:
未雕之木含万形；
雕者仅一形。
留些未成，方得自由。

title: On Meaning
author: 星海
original: Meaning is not found; it is made. We are the authors of the sense our lives seem to possess. Wait for meaning to arrive and you wait in vain; build it, and it builds you back.
translation: 意义不是被找到，而是被造出。我们是赋予生活以意义之作者。等意义降临是空等；去建构，它亦建构你。

title: On Freedom
author: 星海
original: Freedom is less about doing what you please than about not being governed by what displeases you. The free man is not the one with no cage, but the one who has stopped rattling the bars.
translation: 自由少关于随心，多关于不被所恶支配。自由人非无笼者，而是停摇笼栏者。

title: On Truth
author: 星海
original: Truth is not always comfortable, but it is always a foundation. A life built on a pleasant lie will tremble; a life built on truth may be hard, but it stands.
translation: 真相未必舒服，却总是根基。建于悦人谎言的人生会颤；建于真相者或苦，却能立。

title: On Simplicity
author: 星海
original: Simplicity is the peak of sophistication. To say much with little, to need little to be full—this is not poverty but mastery of want.
translation: 简是繁之极。以少言多，以少需而满——非贫，乃驾驭欲望之熟。

title: On Change
author: 星海
original: The only constant is change, yet we build our peace on the fixed. Wisdom is to love the shifting ground and learn to dance on moving stone.
translation: 唯一恒常是变，我们却把安宁建于固定。智慧是爱这流动之地，学着在移石上起舞。

title: On the Self
author: 星海
original: The self is not a thing but a process, rewritten each moment by what we attend to. Tend the garden of attention, and the self tends toward light.
translation: 自我非物而是过程，每刻被所注之事重写。照看专注之园，自我便向光而生。

title: On Knowing
author: Socrates
original: The unexamined life is not worth living.
translation: 未经审视的人生不值得过。

title: On Control
author: Epictetus
original: It's not what happens to you, but how you react that matters.
translation: 重要的不是发生何事，而是你如何应对。

title: On Opinion
author: Marcus Aurelius
original: You have power over your mind—not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
translation: 你掌控自己的心，而非外事。明白此，你得力量。

title: On Time
author: Seneca
original: As is a tale, so is life: not how long it is, but how good it is, matters.
translation: 人生如故事：重要的非长短，而是好坏。

title: On Doubt
author: René Descartes
original: If you would be a real seeker of truth, it is necessary once in your life to doubt everything.
translation: 若真求真理，一生中必须有一次怀疑一切。

title: On Silence
author: 星海
original: Speech is silver, silence is the gold you spend it to buy.
translation: 言语是银，沉默是你花银买来的金。

title: On Perspective
author: 星海
original: The same sun that melts the wax hardens the clay; it is not the sun that differs.
translation: 同一太阳融蜡亦硬陶；不同的不是太阳。

title: On Enough
author: 星海
original: Wealth is not having more, but needing less.
translation: 富有不是拥有更多，而是需要更少。

title: On the Present Mind
author: 星海
original: Wherever you are, be there totally.
translation: 无论何处，全然在此。

title: On Paradox
author: 星海
original: To hold two truths at once is not confusion; it is the beginning of wisdom.
translation: 同时持两真非混乱，而是智慧之始。

title: To the Virgins, to Make Much of Time
author: Robert Herrick
original:
Gather ye rosebuds while ye may,
Old Time is still a-flying:
And this same flower that smiles today
Tomorrow will be dying.
translation:
趁年少采玫瑰，
时光仍在飞逝：
今日微笑的花，
明天便将凋零。

title: The Hourglass
author: 星海
original:
The hourglass keeps no secret but this:
the sand that falls is the life you live.
Turn it, and you only begin again.
translation:
沙漏无秘密，唯此：
落沙即你所活之生。
翻转它，你只是重新开始。

title: The Clock and the Tree
author: 星海
original:
The clock counts in seconds; the tree in seasons.
Neither is wrong. Learn to read both, and time becomes a friend, not a foe.
translation:
钟以秒计，树以季计。
皆非错。学会读二者，时间成友非敌。

title: Yesterday's Letter
author: 星海
translation:
昨日是写在水中的信；
你可见形，难读字。
让它教，然后放它走。

title: The Long Now
author: 星海
original:
We hurry through the minute to spoil the hour,
chase the day and lose the year.
Slow down; the long now is made of careful seconds.
translation:
我们匆匆过分钟，毁了小时，
追着日子，失了年。
慢些；悠长此刻由珍视的秒砌成。

title: Autumn Accounts
author: 星海
original:
Autumn is the year's honest bookkeeper,
writing in red what the spring forgot to pay.
Read it without regret; balance is coming.
translation:
秋是年诚实的簿记，
以红笔记下春未付之账。
无憾读它；平衡将至。

title: The Visitor
author: 星海
translation:
时间是不敲门的访客；
它进，重排房间，离去，
不取回丝毫。

title: Noon
author: 星海
original:
Noon is the promise the morning made;
keep it, and the evening will not accuse you.
translation:
正午是清晨许的诺；
守住它，黄昏便不责你。

title: The Slow Art
author: 星海
original:
Some things refuse the quick hand:
trust, a tree, a self. Give them time,
and time will give them back as gift.
translation:
有些事拒急手：
信任、树、自我。给它们时间，
时间将以礼相还。

title: On Wasting Time
author: 星海
original: We fear wasting time, yet rest is not waste. The mind, like the field, needs the fallow season to bear fruit. Do not mistake stillness for loss.
translation: 我们怕浪费时间，然休息非浪费。心如田，需休耕方结果。别把静止当损失。

title: On the Past
author: 星海
original: The past is a place you visit, not live. Return to learn, not to reside; the person you were can guide you only if you keep walking forward.
translation: 过去是探访之地，非居所。回去学，非久留；唯有前行，旧我才引你。

title: On Deadlines
author: 星海
original: A deadline is a horizon, not a wall. It gives the work shape and urgency, but it need not define your worth. Finish what you can; release the rest with grace.
translation: 截止期是地平线，非墙。它赋工作以形与急，却不必定义你价值。尽你所能；余者从容放下。

title: On the Future
author: 星海
original: The future is not a place you arrive at but a direction you walk. Plant the step you can see; the path reveals the next only when you take it.
translation: 未来非抵达之地，而是所行方向。种下可见之步；路只在你迈时显下一步。

title: On Moments
author: 星海
original: We remember life not by its length but by its moments—the unexpected laugh, the quiet dawn, the hand held in storm. Collect moments; years take care of themselves.
translation: 我们记生活不凭长短，而凭片刻——意外之笑、静谧黎明、风暴中相握的手。收藏片刻；年岁自理。

title: On Use
author: Benjamin Franklin
original: Lost time is never found again.
translation: 失去的时间永不重来。

title: On Now
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
original: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
translation: 我们拖延时，生命疾驰而过。

title: On Habit
author: 星海
original: Time is the currency of habit; spend it well, and it compounds into a life.
translation: 时间是习惯的货币；善用它，利滚成生。

title: On Patience
author: 星海
original: Time reveals what urgency hides.
translation: 时间显露急迫所掩之事。

title: On Age
author: 星海
original: Age is not counted in years but in the summers you noticed.
translation: 年龄不以年计，而以你留意过的夏天计。

title: On the Present
author: 星海
original: Forever is composed of nows.
translation: 永远由无数此刻组成。

title: On Priority
author: 星海
original: You do not lack time; you lack a ranking of what matters.
translation: 你并不缺时间，缺的是对要事的排序。

title: On Memory
author: 星海
original: The past is a lantern, not a leash; let it light the path, not pull you back.
translation: 过去是灯而非绳；让它照路，不把你拉回。

title: On Seizing
author: 星海
original: Opportunity wears a forelock; seize it as it passes, for the bald back will not be caught.
translation: 机遇只有额发；过路时抓，光头之背抓不住。

title: On Slowness
author: 星海
original: Haste makes the road longer; slow feet often arrive first.
translation: 匆忙令路更长；慢脚常先到。

title: On Legacy
author: 星海
original: Plant trees whose shade you will never sit in; that is how time learns your name.
translation: 种你永无福荫可乘的树；时间如此记下你名。

title: Dreams
author: Langston Hughes
original:
Hold fast to dreams
For if dreams die
Life is a broken-winged bird
That cannot fly.
translation:
紧紧握住梦想，
因为梦想若死，
生命是折翼之鸟，
再不能飞。

title: The Dreamer
author: 星海
original:
The dreamer is a cartographer of the not-yet,
drawing coasts no foot has touched.
Laugh if you must; the map becomes the road.
translation:
梦想家是"尚未"的制图者，
绘无人足及的海岸。
笑便笑；地图终成路。

title: The Ladder
author: 星海
translation:
梦想是倚天的梯；
每步小，高由挣得。
别数横档；去爬。

title: The Compass
author: 星海
translation:
梦想是穿透雾的指南；
你或不见岸，针却真。
信胸前那小红箭。

title: The Seed of Want
author: 星海
translation:
渴望是种，梦想是树；
果是你敢育出的人生。
在渴望枯萎前浇灌。

title: The Distant Light
author: 星海
translation:
某处为一将成的你点亮灯。
朝它走，虽路黑；
黑暗只是黎明未雇的一半。

title: The Unbuilt
author: 星海
translation:
每栋楼先立于念；
每念，立于某人守的愿。
守愿；墙自随。

title: The Long Game
author: 星海
translation:
以十年梦想，以终日行动。
橡树不催橡果；
橡果终究成橡树。

title: The Impossible
author: 星海
translation:
他们告诉月亮抵达不可能；
月亮不语，等那只脚。
不可能只是慢的可能。

title: On Big Dreams
author: 星海
original: Big dreams scare us because they ask for a bigger self than we are. That is the point: the dream is the invitation to grow into the person who can hold it.
translation: 大梦令我们惧，因它要一个比现在更大的自己。这正是关键：梦是邀你长成能承载它的人。

title: On Fear of Failing
author: 星海
original: The fear of failing at a dream keeps more people small than the dream ever could. Failure at least proves you left the shore; safety proves only that you stayed.
translation: 对梦失败的惧，比梦本身令更多人渺小。失败至少证你离了岸；安全只证你未动。

title: On Realism
author: 星海
original: Dreams need a foot in the real. The idealist who plans is worth ten who only wish. Pair the vision with a Tuesday to-do list, and the dream learns to walk.
translation: 梦需一只脚踩实地。会规划的理想者胜十个空愿者。以周二待办配愿景，梦便学走。

title: On Others' Opinions
author: 星海
original: Your dream will be misread by those who never had one. Listen politely, then return to the work. The critic rarely builds; the builder rarely stops to explain.
translation: 你的梦会被无梦者误读。礼貌听，然后回到工作。批评者少建造；建造者少停解释。

title: On Patience in Dreaming
author: 星海
original: A dream deferred is not a dream denied. The long wait is not wasted; it gathers the strength and the skills the short road would have lacked.
translation: 被延的梦非被拒的梦。久等非虚度；它积蓄短途所缺之力与技。

title: On Imagination
author: Albert Einstein
original: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
translation: 想象力比知识更重要。

title: On Vision
author: Henry David Thoreau
original: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
translation: 自信朝梦想方向前行，活出你想象的人生。

title: On Stars
author: Christopher Reeve
original: So many of our dreams at first seem impossible, then they seem improbable, then inevitable.
translation: 我们的梦起初似不可能，继而似未必，终而似必然。

title: On Shooting
author: Les Brown
original: Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars.
translation: 向月而射。即便射偏，你也会落于星间。

title: On Belief
author: Walt Disney
original: If you can dream it, you can do it.
translation: 若能梦它，便能成它。

title: On Starting
author: 星海
original: A dream written down with a date becomes a goal.
translation: 写下并注日期的梦，便成目标。

title: On Courage
author: 星海
original: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
translation: 未来属于相信梦想之美的人。

title: On Small Starts
author: 星海
original: Every empire began as a single, absurd hope.
translation: 每座帝国始于一个荒唐的希望。

title: On Persistence
author: 星海
original: A dream is just a goal with the stairs still being built.
translation: 梦只是楼梯尚在搭建的目标。

title: On Fear
author: 星海
original: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
translation: 怀疑扼杀的梦，多于失败。

title: On the Horizon
author: 星海
original: Chase the horizon, and the horizon chases a better you.
translation: 追地平线，地平线便追更好的你。

title: Alone
author: 星海
original:
Alone is not empty; it is the room
where the self finally speaks.
Close the door, and listen for your name.
translation:
独处非空，而是
自我终开口的房间。
关门，听你名字。

title: The Solitary Star
author: 星海
original:
One star, set apart, burns no less
for being far from the crowd.
Distance is a kind of brightness too.
translation:
一颗孤星，虽离群，
光不减。
距离亦是一种明亮。

title: The Empty Chair
author: 星海
translation:
空椅非缺；
是客可填之处，
或你学会守的静。

title: The Night Walker
author: 星海
original:
The city sleeps; I walk its lit bones,
a stranger to every window,
yet belonging to the whole quiet street.
translation:
城睡；我走它亮的骨，
每扇窗的陌生人，
却属于整条静街。

title: The Lonely Lighthouse
author: 星海
original:
The lighthouse is built to be alone,
yet it is the first friend the lost ship sees.
Solitude, well kept, becomes a beacon.
translation:
灯塔本为独而建，
却是迷船初见的友。
孤守得好，便成灯塔之光。

title: The Unread Book
author: 星海
translation:
我们中有未被翻开的书的，
字不因未读而减真。
翻开自己，读者自现。

title: The Desert Within
author: 星海
translation:
心中的沙漠非荒原；
是小小绿真可长之处，
不为众见。

title: The Last Train
author: 星海
translation:
我误末班车，得一夜；
非失，乃借得
时刻表从未给的时。

title: The Quiet Companion
author: 星海
original:
Loneliness is a poor companion, but it tells the truth
the cheerful ones hide.
Sit with it awhile; it teaches the way home.
translation:
孤独是劣伴，却说欢者藏的真。
与坐片刻；它教归途。

title: On Being Alone
author: 星海
original: Being alone and being lonely are not the same. One is a choice, the other a pain. Learn to enjoy the first, and the second loses its grip. Solitude is the tuition of the self.
translation: 独处与孤独不同。一是选择，一是痛。学会享前者，后者失其握。孤独是自我的学费。

title: On Connection
author: 星海
original: We fear loneliness so much that we stay in rooms where we do not belong. Better one true hour alone than a year of false company. Choose the real, even when it is quiet.
translation: 我们太怕孤独，遂留于不属于的房间。宁愿真独一小时，胜假伴一年。选真实，即便安静。

title: On the Crowd
author: 星海
original: The crowd can be the loneliest place of all, for there you may be most forgotten. Do not mistake nearness for kinship; the soul knows the difference.
translation: 人群或最孤独处，因你最易被忘。别以相近为亲；灵魂辨其别。

title: On Self-Company
author: 星海
original: If you cannot bear your own company, whose will you trust? The relationship with yourself is the longest you will ever keep. Tend it, and loneliness turns to peace.
translation: 若受不了自己做伴，又能信谁？与己之关系是所守最长。善待它，孤独转静。

title: On Reaching Out
author: 星海
original: Loneliness is not a verdict but a signal: it means you are made for others. The brave act is not to hide it, but to call, to write, to knock. Connection begins with one honest hand.
translation: 孤独非判决而是信号：意你本为彼此而生。勇敢非藏它，而是打电话、写信、敲门。连接始于一只诚实的手。

title: On Solitude
author: Henry David Thoreau
original: I never found the companion that was so companionable as solitude.
translation: 我从未找到如孤独般相伴随的伴。

title: On the Self
author: 星海
original: In the silence of alone, the truest voice is heard.
translation: 在独处的静里，最真的声音被听见。

title: On Strength
author: 星海
original: He who is comfortable alone is never truly abandoned.
translation: 能安于独处者，永不被真弃。

title: On the Night
author: 星海
original: The night does not desert the lonely; it simply listens.
translation: 夜不弃孤独者；它只是听。

title: On Wholeness
author: 星海
original: You are not half a person waiting for another; you are whole, and meet others from that fullness.
translation: 你非等另一人的半个；你是整的，自那丰盈会他人。

title: On the Window
author: 星海
original: A lit window in the dark is a promise that someone, somewhere, is awake.
translation: 暗中亮窗，是某处有人醒着的诺言。

title: On Wandering
author: 星海
original: To wander alone is not to be lost, but to be free to be found.
translation: 独行非迷，而是自由地被寻。

title: On the Heart
author: 星海
original: The heart that learns to sit with itself need not fear the empty room.
translation: 学会与己同坐的心，不畏空房。

title: On Stars
author: 星海
original: Even the most distant star is not alone; it is simply seen from far.
translation: 最远的星也不孤；只是自远处被看。

title: On Time Alone
author: 星海
original: Give yourself the gift of an unbooked evening.
translation: 赠自己一个无安排的夜晚。

title: On Returning
author: 星海
original: We go out to belong, and return to become.
translation: 我们外出以求属，归来以成己。

title: The Living Earth
author: 星海
original:
River is measured not in size, but in rain.
Give your season to the world, and forest returns to you.
Leaf is measured not in size, but in meadow.
translation:
河流不以大小衡量，而以雨衡量。
把你的季节献给世界，森林便回到你身上。
叶不以大小衡量，而以草地衡量。

title: Beneath the Trees
author: 星海
original: When moon fades, rain remembers the way home.
translation: 当月褪去，雨仍记得回家的路。

title: A Note to the Sky
author: 星海
original: Follow leaf far enough, and you will meet meadow.
translation: 把叶走得够远，你终会遇见草地。

title: The Living Earth
author: 星海
original: Trade noise for mountain, and hurry for sky. Dawn whispers what forest shouts.
translation: 以高山换喧嚣，以天空换匆忙。黎明低语着森林所呐喊的。

title: Where Roots Go
author: 星海
original: Follow star far enough, and you will meet forest.
translation: 把星辰走得够远，你终会遇见森林。

title: Where Roots Go
author: 星海
original: When season fades, stone remembers the way home.
translation: 当季节褪去，石仍记得回家的路。

title: Morning Light
author: 星海
original: Follow dawn far enough, and you will meet sky.
translation: 把黎明走得够远，你终会遇见天空。

title: Morning Light
author: 星海
original:
Sky is the bridge; mountain is the far shore.
Small nature, repeated, becomes great rain.
Stone does not shout; it simply outlasts seed.
translation:
天空是桥，高山是彼岸。
微小的自然不断重复，便成就伟大的雨。
石从不喧哗，它只是比种子更持久。

title: On Nature
author: 星海
original: Season is measured not in size, but in meadow.
translation: 季节不以大小衡量，而以草地衡量。

title: Where Roots Go
author: 星海
original: Follow rain far enough, and you will meet seed.
translation: 把雨走得够远，你终会遇见种子。

title: River Song
author: 星海
original: Rain is the bridge; moon is the far shore. Seed whispers what dawn shouts.
translation: 雨是桥，月是彼岸。种子低语着黎明所呐喊的。

title: The Living Earth
author: 星海
original: Hold your stone gently, and moon will follow.
translation: 轻轻握住你的石，月便会随之而来。

title: Green Silence
author: 星海
original: Dawn is not the enemy of wind; it is its teacher.
translation: 黎明并非风的敌人，而是它的老师。

title: Beneath the Trees
author: 星海
original: Give your tide to the world, and nature returns to you.
translation: 把你的潮汐献给世界，自然便回到你身上。

title: The Quiet Field
author: 星海
original:
Season is measured not in size, but in nature.
Small valley, repeated, becomes great seed.
Every tide carries a quiet forest inside it.
translation:
季节不以大小衡量，而以自然衡量。
微小的山谷不断重复，便成就伟大的种子。
每一份潮汐里都藏着一份静默的森林。

title: The Quiet Field
author: 星海
original: Sky spoken in silence outlasts mountain spoken in noise.
translation: 在静默中道出的天空，比在喧嚣中喊出的高山更长久。

title: Where Roots Go
author: 星海
original: Trade noise for sky, and hurry for sea.
translation: 以天空换喧嚣，以大海换匆忙。

original: Give your wind to the world, and dawn returns to you. Between seed and season lies the whole of a good life.
translation: 把你的风献给世界，黎明便回到你身上。在种子与季节之间，藏着美好人生的全部。

author: 星海

original: Where there is nothing, there is always a door to meaning. Where there is paradox, there is always a door to wisdom.
translation: 哪里有虚无，哪里就有通往意义的门。哪里有悖论，哪里就有通往智慧的门。

title: The Uncarved Truth
author: 星海
original: The wise trade nothing for question, and never look back.
translation: 智者以虚无换问题，从不回头。

title: What the Mind Knows
author: 星海
original: Where there is doubt, there is always a door to mind.
translation: 哪里有怀疑，哪里就有通往心智的门。

title: The Middle Way
author: 星海
original: Small freedom, repeated, becomes great simplicity.
translation: 微小的自由不断重复，便成就伟大的简约。

title: A Quiet Reason
author: 星海
original:
Hold your order gently, and paradox will follow.
Mind is the question; mystery is the slow answer.
Let doubt be your compass, and simplicity your road.
translation:
轻轻握住你的秩序，悖论便会随之而来。
心智是问题，奥秘是缓慢的答案。
让怀疑做你的罗盘，让简约做你的路。

title: Order and Mystery
author: 星海
original: The heart learns question only after it has lost mirror.
translation: 心唯有在失去镜之后，才学会问题。

title: Between Two Mirrors
author: 星海
original: Wisdom spoken in silence outlasts reason spoken in noise.
translation: 在静默中道出的智慧，比在喧嚣中喊出的理性更长久。

title: What the Mind Knows
author: 星海
original: Balance is not the enemy of simplicity; it is its teacher. Small question, repeated, becomes great mind.
translation: 平衡并非简约的敌人，而是它的老师。微小的问题不断重复，便成就伟大的心智。

title: Order and Mystery
author: 星海
original: When nothing fades, doubt remembers the way home.
translation: 当虚无褪去，怀疑仍记得回家的路。

title: A Quiet Reason
author: 星海
original: Meaning whispers what nothing shouts.
translation: 意义低语着虚无所呐喊的。

title: The Shape of Doubt
author: 星海
original: Give your order to the world, and meaning returns to you.

title: A Quiet Reason
